title: Hand-offs, a fast answer, a talk-over, a follow-up that interrupts the answer, an interrupted question, a backchannel

utterances.speaker: Ingrid
utterances.text: Can you tell me about yourself and your background?

utterances.speaker: the owner
utterances.text: Sure. I lead data engineering at a logistics start up, and I built an invoice extraction pipeline called Lantern.

utterances.speaker: Ingrid
utterances.text: What do you know about our company and product?

utterances.speaker: the owner
utterances.text: You build dispatch software for freight companies.
utterances.role: fast answer, 150 ms after the question

utterances.speaker: Ingrid
utterances.role: question that the owner talks over

utterances.speaker: the owner
utterances.text: Between seventy and eighty thousand gross.
utterances.role: starts 0.6 s before the question ends

utterances.speaker: Ingrid
utterances.text: How did you choose between small and large models?
utterances.role: follow-up that interrupts the end of the answer

utterances.speaker: the owner
utterances.text: I tested both on a labelled sample and picked the small model for cost.

utterances.speaker: Ingrid
utterances.text: Could you walk me through how you would approach building an LLM assisted dispatcher for our four country operation?
utterances.role: long question that the owner interrupts half way

utterances.speaker: the owner
utterances.text: Sorry, one second, let me share my screen first.

utterances.speaker: Ingrid
utterances.text: So, a bit about us. We are about two hundred people across four countries, and we ship around ten thousand loads a week.

utterances.speaker: the owner
utterances.role: backchannel in the middle of the statement
